votes.quote: The code is split into separate units. `src/rateLimiter.ts` holds the `SlidingWindowLimiter`. `src/relay.ts` holds the retry loop in `Relay`, with forwarding in a separate injected `httpSend` function of type `Send`. `src/server.ts` handles HTTP. Time and the network are controllable in tests: "Time and the network are injected (`Clock`, `Send`)", and the tests use a `FakeClock`. Rate-limit state is kept per tenant: `const limiters = new Map<string, SlidingWindowLimiter>(); for (const [id, t] of tenants) { limiters.set(id, new SlidingWindowLimiter(t.requestsPerSecond, () => clock.now())); }`
